_doc: How the L2 bench app (tests/l2/app.py, bench.py) judges each bench test. Titles, purpose and conditions come from tests/catalogue.json; the step text comes from the bench sheet (the catalogue 'source'); limits are copied unchanged from the sheet. A criterion has one or more parts, all of which must pass: 'value' (expression over the scope's own measurements, judged against lo/hi, INFO without them; with 'points' and 'agg' (max, min, maxabs) the worst over several capture points), 'telemetry' (list of conditions on the firmware console over the step window: from Start step, or the first key sent in the step, to Finish step), 'operator' (true: the operator's PASS/FAIL; 'info': text, optional when another part exists). In 'value', NAME(sig) or NAME(sig1,sig2) is the scope measurement of type NAME (as MEASUrement:MEASx:TYPe? returns it) on the channels the session maps those signals to; DELAY_RISE_FALL(a,b) is the scope DELAY from a rising edge of a to the next falling edge of b (any RISE/FALL pair); abs, max, min are plain functions. 'Configure scope' in the app creates the missing ones. A test's 'channels' rewires channels for that step only. A telemetry condition may carry 'after_key' (from the last time that key was sent in the step) and 'before_key' (until the first time after that).

default_channels._source: docs/testing/bench/inverter-session.md, Bench setup: CH1 differential probe inverter side, CH2 differential probe grid side, CH3 current probe on the AC line, CH4 relay command (GPIO 22)

standard_measurements._doc: Created by 'Configure scope' on every channel of that kind (scope measurement types).

keys._doc: Firmware menu keys the app can send (src/main.cpp, menu h). confirm: text shown before sending.

L2-INV-09._doc: Dead time and the 100 Hz line current (hypothesis 2026-11-13: dead time with a small DC line current makes the even harmonic). The 100 Hz amplitude per capture comes from the stored waveforms (CH3), analysed offline; the telemetry dt and the capture settings record the dead time.
L2-INV-09.point_help: For each point: x, set the dead time with w / s (telemetry dt), c, G, wait 2 s in GRID_CONNECTED, tick waveforms, Acquire the point (CH3 at 1 A/div, 10 ms/div), then x. Same Kp, Ti and ff 0 for all points

criteria.desc: Telemetry dt matches each point (100, 160, 220, 300 ns) when it was captured

Does the 100 Hz scale with the dead time? (confirms or rejects the hypothesis)

L2-INV-11._doc: The 100 Hz line current with and without the feedforward filter (DC block and 2ω notch, key D). Hypothesis (2026-11-13): the measured feedforward copies the node's 100 Hz and DC (gain 0.965) and amplifies an internal source about 9×; with the filter the copy gain there is about 0, predicted about 10× less 100 Hz. Amplitudes from the CH3 waveforms and the firmware dumps (q, then r), analysed offline.
L2-INV-11.point_help: Same Kp, Ti, dead time and ff 0 for both. ffn0: telemetry ffn 0, c, G, wait 2 s, tick waveforms, Acquire, then q, wait, r; x. ffn1: in OFF press D (telemetry ffn 1), c, wait 2 s (the filter settles), G, wait 2 s, tick waveforms, Acquire, q, r; x. Default 2 kHz (no v)

criteria.desc: Telemetry ffn 0 and 1 at the two points; same Kp, Ti, dt
